	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_asceticism status = prohibited } } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_asceticism } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_at_least_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_asceticism status = permitted } } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_at_least_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_asceticism status = known } } value = 2 }
}
